Status Definitions: 
Live = The game has launched and is playable on the operator’s site
Under Development = The game is currently in development (art, GDD, QA)
Production Ready = The product is completed with QA tested, pending integration with the aggregator
Integrated = The product has been integrated with the aggregator but has not yet gone live
Retired = The product has been permanently taken down
Maintenance = The product is temporarily taken offline for fixes or updates
Not Started = The product is in a very early concept stage, with only initial ideas defined
On Hold = The product is put on-hold till further notice.
